CELL CITY1.1

An animal cell, built as a town.

WALK SPEED20
How fast you move in Walk Mode.
JUMP HEIGHT1.0x
Multiplies how high you jump.
CAR COLORRED
Each player gets their own color. Crossed-out ones are taken.
FREE SPEED UPGRADE (side effects may apply)
LOW DETAIL
Hides the grass and draws at normal resolution. The biggest speed-up for slow computers.
WAVES
Turn off for calm, flat water on the lake if it lags.
WAVE HEIGHT1 FT
How tall the waves are, bottom to top, for everyone in the city. Big waves let the CellDoo jump. All the way left = flat calm; the dock and ramp stay sheltered. The newest change wins, but an admin's change beats everyone's.
All of these are remembered on this device.
VEHICLE
F1: MOTOCELL racer, more grip and speed. Truck: lifted pickup, with engine sounds.
EXTRA SPEED
Cranks walk + drive speed way up. Shows on the Settings speed slider.
ANNOUNCEMENT
Pops up big on every player's screen.
PLAYERS
KICK sends a player back to the menu, and they can't rejoin for 5 minutes. Owners can't be kicked.
WAVES1 FT
Your waves beat everyone's - even admins'.
The ADMIN tab is unlocked for you too.

PRACTICE - TOP 10

Loading...
Your best score for each nickname counts. Play PRACTICE to get on the board!

LOOK AROUND

  • Drag to spin the camera, scroll to zoom.
  • Click any building to learn which organelle it is, with a real microscope photo.
  • KEY lists every organelle and its building.

WALK MODE

  • WASD or arrow keys to walk, mouse to look, Space to jump.
  • Click a building (aim with the +) to inspect it. Esc to stop.

DRIVE MODE

  • W / S to go and brake, A / D to steer, mouse to look around.
  • The race track is east, over the bridge. Type /speed miles in chat for MPH.

THE LAKE & THE CELLDOO

  • Don't walk or drive into the water - you'll drown and respawn on land.
  • Walk to the dock (south gate) and press E to ride the CellDoo jet ski. E at the dock or the ramp to get off - or run it up onto the beach and hop off there.
  • Big waves let you jump - land badly or turn too sharp and you might wipe out!
  • Left it out on the lake? Stand on the dock and press R to call it back.
  • Other players can see your CellDoo wherever you leave it.

PRACTICE

  • Press PRACTICE (top right). You get 15 seconds to click the building for the organelle it shows - by name or by microscope photo. 10 rounds; faster = more points.

PLAYING TOGETHER

  • T or Enter to chat. /help lists the chat commands.
  • On the website: same class code = same city.
  • Everyone gets their own car color. The wave height is shared by everyone.

ON A PHONE OR TABLET

  • Drag with one finger to spin the city, pinch to zoom, tap a building to inspect it.
  • In Walk or Drive Mode: drag to look, the arrow pad to move, and the JUMP, E, R, H and CHAT buttons. EXIT is at the top.

SLOW COMPUTER?

  • PERFORMANCE tab: turn on Low Detail, or turn the waves off.
